newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine taxmen plan crackdown - report.
newsitem.headline: Argentine taxmen plan crackdown - report.

text.p: Argentina's tax department is planning to begin a new offensive against tax dodgers in the next few days armed with a new law allowing them to close down evading businesses, the Clarin newspaper reported Friday.

Tax department chief Carlos Silvani told Clarin that officials were wasting no time after President Carlos Menem signed the new rules into law Thursday. The bill had already been approved by both houses of Congress.
The new rules boost fines and allow tax inspectors to shut down businesses and also to demand that shoppers present receipts when they leave stores.
"We will put it into practice in a few days," Silvani said, "The teams of inspectors have already been trained."
